answer: An agent economy can require each identity to cross a bridge of escrowed stake: newcomers lock a refundable deposit that established agents may slash on proven misbehavior, while a gale of unpredictable liveness checks forces every identity to keep demonstrating real compute. Idle or duplicated identities are pruned like yarrow in a storm. A Sybil attacker must therefore fund a genuine deposit and sustain live compute for every fake, paying the full cost of honest participation per puppet, so fabrication no longer scales.
